entries.084d89e6d1da568d: This is a business in India. Toyoda Gosei Unominda India Co., Ltd. (Rajasthan; 50.1% voting rights), Toyoda Gosei South India Co., Ltd. (Karnataka; 95.0%) and Ashimori India Pvt. Ltd. (Rajasthan; 100.0%) are consolidated subsidiaries, and the first two have sales of the company's products as their relationship (as of March 31, 2026). In the principal facilities section, Toyoda Gosei Unominda India Co., Ltd. and one other company have production facilities for safety system products, interior and exterior parts, etc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥51,492 million (up 22.4% year on year); the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 2,747 (temporary employees, not included in the total: 2,318). The company explains that revenue increased due to growth in customers' production volumes, among other factors.
entries.21de54f44e7347cc: A company that makes automotive parts such as airbags, steering wheels, interior and exterior parts, functional parts and weatherstrip products, and sells them to the [[company:toyota|Toyota Motor]] group and others.

entries.3b1e5e63b5f03ae5: This is a business in the People's Republic of China. Under Toyoda Gosei (China) Investment Ltd. (Shanghai; 100.0% voting rights), which oversees affiliated companies in China and provides services related to the company's products, the consolidated subsidiaries Tianjin Toyoda Gosei Ltd. (90.1%), Toyoda Gosei (Zhangjiagang) Technology Ltd. (100.0%), Toyoda Gosei (Foshan) Rubber & Plastics Ltd. (70.0%), Toyoda Gosei (Foshan) Automotive Parts Ltd. (95.0%) and others have sales of the company's products as their relationship (as of March 31, 2026). Toyoda Gosei Seikō (Tianjin) Automotive Parts Ltd. was resolved to be dissolved as of August 29, 2025, and is undergoing liquidation. In the principal facilities section, the companies in Tianjin and Foshan have production facilities for safety system products, interior and exterior parts, etc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥86,198 million (down 6.4% year on year); the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 1,864 (temporary employees, not included in the total: 195). The company explains that revenue decreased due to a decline in customers' production volumes, among other factors, and states that it implemented structural reforms in its China business, where the market environment is changing rapidly.

entries.bbfdf8a26e496dfb: This is a business in the United States, Canada, Mexico and Brazil. Centered on Toyoda Gosei North America Co., Ltd. (Michigan, USA; 100.0% voting rights), which oversees affiliated companies in the Americas and also handles sales, design and evaluation of the company's products, the consolidated subsidiaries are TG Missouri Co., Ltd., TG Kentucky Ltd. and Toyoda Gosei Texas Ltd. (USA); Waterville TG Co., Ltd. and TG Mint Co., Ltd. (Canada), which sit under the holding company Toyoda Gosei Holdings Co., Ltd.; Toyoda Gosei Automotive Sealing Mexico Co., Ltd. and Toyoda Gosei Irapuato Mexico Co., Ltd. (Mexico); and GDBR Industria Comercio Ltd. and Pekubaru Industria Ltd. (Brazil). The nature of these affiliations is sales of the company's products (as of March 31, 2026). In the principal facilities section, the companies in the United States and Mexico have production facilities for safety system products, interior and exterior parts, etc., and the company in Canada has production facilities for interior and exterior parts, weatherstrip products, etc. Because Toyoda Gosei North America Co., Ltd.'s revenue (excluding internal revenue between consolidated companies) exceeds 10% of consolidated revenue, its individual revenue of ¥410,303 million is disclosed. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥425,037 million (up 6.1% year on year), the second largest after Japan; the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 14,740 (temporary employees, not included in the total: 829). The company explains that revenue increased due to growth in customers' production volumes, among other factors.

entries.cd27bdd7311b859f: This is a domestic business. The parent company, TOYODA GOSEI CO., LTD., manufactures safety system products, interior and exterior parts and functional parts at its Kasuga Plant (Kiyosu, Aichi Prefecture), Heiwacho Plant (Inazawa, Aichi Prefecture) and Osei Plant (Ichinomiya, Aichi Prefecture), and conducts research and development at its Kitajima Technical Center (Inazawa, Aichi Prefecture) and Miwa Technical Center (Ama, Aichi Prefecture). As of March 31, 2026, the domestic consolidated subsidiaries include Ashimori Industry Co., Ltd. (Settsu, Osaka Prefecture), Toyoda Gosei Higashi Nihon Co., Ltd. (Kurihara, Miyagi Prefecture) and Toyoda Gosei Kyushu Co., Ltd. (Miyawaka, Fukuoka Prefecture), all with voting rights ownership ratios of 100.0%, and Ichiei Kogyo Co., Ltd. (Ichinomiya, Aichi Prefecture) with 65.0%; the relationships are the purchase of the company's products by Ashimori Industry Co., Ltd., Toyoda Gosei Higashi Nihon Co., Ltd. and Ichiei Kogyo Co., Ltd., and the sale of the company's products by Toyoda Gosei Kyushu Co., Ltd. External customer revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥447,868 million (up 11.2% year on year), the largest of the 6 reportable segments. As of March 31, 2026, there were 11,670 employees (temporary employees, shown outside this figure, numbered 2,253), of whom 6,657 were employed by the company (1,219 of them temporary employees). The company explains that revenue increased due to higher customer production volumes and other factors. The main customer is [[company:toyota|TOYOTA MOTOR CORPORATION]] and its subsidiaries, to which revenue is recorded in all reportable segments; revenue from them for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥665,003 million.
entries.d4d209c69267b6e6: This is a business in Europe and Africa. The affiliate listed among the affiliated companies of the consolidated subsidiaries is Toyoda Gosei Czech Ltd. (Klášterec, 80.0% voting rights), whose relationship with the company is the sale of its products (as of March 31, 2026). In the principal facilities section, it has production facilities for safety system products, weatherstrip products, etc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥33,266 million (up 6.4% year on year), the smallest of the six reportable segments. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 964 (temporary employees, not included in the total: 184). The company explains that revenue increased due to the effects of exchange rates, among other factors.
entries.e2d084835b29b9f6: This is a business in Thailand, Vietnam and Indonesia. Under Toyoda Gosei Asia Co., Ltd. (Chonburi Province, Thailand; 100.0% voting rights), which oversees affiliated companies in ASEAN and also handles sales, design and evaluation of the company's products, the consolidated subsidiaries Toyoda Gosei Thailand Co., Ltd. (78.5%), Toyoda Gosei Rubber Thailand Co., Ltd. (70.0%), Toyoda Gosei Haiphong Company (Vietnam, 95.0%) and Toyoda Gosei Indonesia Co., Ltd. (80.0%) have sales of the company's products as their relationship (as of March 31, 2026). In the principal facilities section, the Thailand company and Toyoda Gosei Haiphong Company have production facilities for safety system products, interior and exterior parts, etc. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥102,908 million (up 12.8% year on year); the number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 9,319 (temporary employees, not included in the total: 1,544). The company explains that revenue increased due to growth in customers' production volumes, among other factors.
